catalogue.note: Rebuilt from a screenshot (image2code), not from Figma layers: an iPhone screenshot pasted into Figma, 1170 x 2532, the 3x render of a 390 x 844 screen, stored as a JPEG, so one source pixel is 0.33px and nothing is measured finer. The diff is against that screenshot at 3x, pixels differing by more than 24 levels, measured on the build that carries the screenshot's own text: 2.67% of the screen, 0.69% outside the text boxes, 11.6% inside them (glyph edges). The IBAN shown here is made up (same shape and width as the one in the screenshot) and it is painted out of the stored source picture; nothing else differs from the measured build. Text is live Inter 4 (variable, embedded whole, optical size following the font size): 11px for labels and values, 14px for names, buttons and the header account line, 16 to 16.75px titles, 41px/700 amount, 28px/600 pad digits; sizes fitted by string advance, weights by ink mass and shape. Per string the advance is within 1 source pixel for most and up to 3 (0.5 to 1%) for a few. The status-bar time is Inter 17px/600 standing in for the system face. Corners are plain border-radius (24px cards, pills at half height), not iOS continuous corners. Built as revolut-transfer-03 underneath, a 48% black dim, then the sheet with a real backdrop blur (8px) and a translucent grey tint; the white band near the bottom is the Send button showing through. Not reproduced: the lens-like bending of that glow at the sheet's left, right and bottom rims (the system's glass refracts there; CSS blur does not), which is most of the 0.69% outside the text; the sheet's rim highlights are modelled with inset lines. Sheet text is 10.56px, labels 10.4 to 10.5px/500, title 17.27px/700. Traced as SVG: warning triangle (and those of the screen beneath); status-bar icons shared with revolut-transfer-06. Raster: the bank badge of the screen beneath. Every text carrying personal or account data has a data-field attribute. No frame chrome.
